commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src conda run -n autodrift python -m autodrift.input_observability_audit --env-config configs/ppo_m88_wheel_masked_friction_aux_driver.json --episodes 16 --seed 9301 --policy heuristic --horizon-steps 15 --sample-stride 4 --max-samples 300 --ridge 0.1 --run-dir runs/m91a_input_observability_smoke_seed9301
commands.name: input_observability_smoke

decision_rule: Pass only as a harness smoke if the command produces samples, probe summary, profile gain summary, summary JSON, and a result note. Do not promote any input profile from this smoke.
failure_criteria: samples.csv, probe_summary.csv, profile_gain_summary.csv, summary.json, or result note is missing
the smoke is interpreted as a final wheel/no-wheel conclusion
hypothesis: A lightweight supervised future-envelope probe can compare no-wheel and wheel-response input profiles before PPO training.
success_criteria: the harness writes all required artifacts
the result note clearly separates harness validation from scientific conclusion
the next task is a formal M91-B audit rather than PPO continuation
